content:
Kim Kardashian and Kanye West’s eldest daughter, North West, has shared she aspires to be more than just a musician.

In a new interview with Dazed, the 13-year-old revealed she would like to work at America’s favorite coffee chain when she turns 14.

West shared her plans after being asked what she would be if she wasn’t an artist. West dropped her six-track debut EP, “N0rth4evr,” in May. Most recently, she dropped a music video for her song “Aishite” on Aug. 6.

“I still wanna work. I wanna work at, like, Starbucks next year. I think I can next year because I’m gonna be 14, so… I think I can. I want to have a regular job, I guess,” she said in the interview published Monday.

West told the outlet that while she once aspired to be a basketball player, she no longer envisions herself being an athlete.

Earlier in the interview, West also shared what she thinks separates her from other kids in her generation.

“Everyone’s in love with boys, vaping and doing all kinds of bad stuff,” she said. “All I want is blue hair and piercings.”

West’s mom said in a confessional ahead of the Season 6 premiere of Hulu’s “The Kardashians” that she was “really conflicted” over her daughter’s music career.

“So we’re going to talk about that soon,” Kim Kardashian said in the February 2025 clip shared with People. “I just really want to make sure that everything’s really well balanced. All of the work experiences are balanced out with just enough fun life experiences. I just want balance.”
